title: Antibiotic Resistance of P. aeruginosa from the Buriganga River
text: plot shows, antibiotic, share 50 isolates tested susceptible, intermediate resistant. Resistance concentrated cefotaxime tetracycline, 88 percent isolates resistant, every isolate susceptible piperacillin-tazobactam.
code: library(burigangaamr) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2)  shares <- burigangaamr |>   count(antibiotic, interpretation) |>   group_by(antibiotic) |>   mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>   ungroup()  antibiotic_order <- shares |>   group_by(antibiotic) |>   summarise(resistant = sum(share[interpretation == "resistant"])) |>   arrange(resistant) |>   pull(antibiotic)  shares |>   mutate(antibiotic = factor(antibiotic, levels = antibiotic_order)) |>   ggplot(aes(x = share, y = antibiotic, fill = interpretation)) +   geom_col() +   scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +   scale_fill_manual(values = c(susceptible = "#5B8E7D",                                intermediate = "#E1B12C",                                resistant = "#B5473B")) +   labs(x = "Share of the 50 isolates", y = NULL, fill = NULL,        title = "Disc diffusion results per antibiotic") +   theme_minimal()

Journal Water Health, 22(12). https://doi.org/10.2166/wh.2024.270. article supplement published Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. original authors listed package data contributors; reviewed package. changed material. eight Word tables supplement read R (script data-raw/data_processing.R). two isolate antibiotic matrices (zone diameters table S3, interpretations table S4) reshaped one observation per isolate antibiotic, antibiotic codes expanded names, classes disc contents tables S1 S2, breakpoints table S2 split numbers, counts per isolate derived observations. Tables S5, S7 S8 summaries republished; processing script reproduces every percentage S5 S8 data. Two statements supplement article agree , package keeps supplement : Table S6 flags 14 isolates multidrug resistant, table S7 abstract count 13. difference isolate B1c, resistant two antibiotic classes. abstract reports 4 percent isolates (two) resistant imipenem meropenem; table S4 one isolate . sampling dates names seven sites given article, open automated readers; package records sites letter codes.
